factors.A: Panel structure and independently verified resource rows
factors.B: Native Windows Verdana complete-number decoding with full-region evidence
factors.C: Current-frame geometry/font caching and capture-scale calibration

evaluation_policy.development: Refinement and candidate selection; retain observations from rejected iterations.
evaluation_policy.test: Previously inspected test partition is regression evidence only. No claim of untouched holdout generalization.
evaluation_policy.reference: Supplemental original crops are reported separately from full screenshots.
evaluation_policy.inputs: Unchanged real originals only for acceptance; annotation boxes only in explicitly labeled component diagnosis, never passed to full-frame readers.
evaluation_policy.generated: Existing and new generated perturbations are guard diagnostics, never pooled with real acceptance data.
evaluation_policy.truth: No annotation, readability or split changes based on outputs; hidden, clipped or ambiguous evidence remains unknown.

execution.platform: Windows with locally installed Verdana; native font backend required for primary factorial run
execution.timing: Native base-font preparation separately; fresh reader and autonomous discovery per original/variant; first read, 50 static cached four-field reads, then 50 new Frame objects containing identical pixels. Separately labeled generated timing diagnostic: 20 one-pixel background changes outside panel/evidence to invalidate whole-frame equality; excluded from real accuracy. Frame copying excluded. Capture, live freshness and action latency remain unmeasured.
execution.font_distribution: Render the installed font locally. Do not commit a font file or converted per-glyph font atlas.

promotion_gates.coverage: Improve correct readable-field coverage over the contemporaneous baseline, or preserve coverage with at least 10% lower paired new-Frame p95 on commonly detected full screenshots.

required_comparisons: Development, historical test regression, full screenshots, supplemental crops and safety controls separately
